controller.scope: Transport joint preset, carrier layout proposal and timed cone manipulation reference. Native CAD contact fitting, feedback and final carton handoff are calibrated in MuJoCo.

robot: Boston Dynamics Spot with Spot Arm
cone_credit: Traffic Cone by Naveen Manja (CC BY)
collision_geometry: Seven convex slices fitted to the visible scanned mesh, including its square foot. All three cones use the same registration.
controller_detail: Two opposed jaw contacts enable a compliant grasp constraint. Measured contact with the staging board releases it. The jaw is torque-limited. The robot follows a curb-side reference with alternating support feet.
